items.content_html:
Turn your Raspberry Pi into an ad-blocking, containerized, DNS wizard. No cape required.

Let’s be honest. You’re here because you’ve heard about Pi-hole — the magical little tool that blocks ads across your entire network — and you want it running on your Raspberry Pi without installing 12 dependencies and sacrificing a goat to the networking gods.
items.title: How to Run Pi-hole in Docker on a Raspberry Pi (and Look Like a Tech Wizard)
items.summary: Turn your Raspberry Pi into an ad-blocking, containerized, DNS wizard. No cape required.
